stop: Stop spending when the stage-1 grid (arch x diversity x seeds, SMC-T1 on the test split, T2 episodes) is complete or the $35 owner cap for 2026-11-25 is reached.
_doc: DRAFT for Stage B/C on <=8 interruptible 3090s. Every unit_s below is an ESTIMATE from A0 (results/stageA/A0_throughput.csv, 4070 Ti SUPER, 3090 assumed 1.25x slower) until the owning role pastes its pilot line into `pilot`. make_jobs.py refuses to emit submittable jobs for a group without `pilot`. Stage 2 groups need the stage-1 outputs pulled back (extra_inputs) and fresh boxes (inputs are pushed once per box).

groups.name: t2-episodes
groups.pilot: stress 2026-11-25: NUMBA_NUM_THREADS=4 python -m cfcap.runner t2_eval --shard 0 --n-shards 1 --out /tmp/t2ev --mode simulate --split test --episodes 3 --per-unit 3 on the 4070 host (i7, 4 numba threads): 1.52 s/episode (23 candidates/episode, labels + parent v2 obs), peak RSS 0.66 GB, no GPU; unit of 100 episodes = 152 s at 4 threads (a box with more cores is faster). Needs torch (CPU imports) + numba 0.68 + input crane_ml (scripts/stage_crane_t2.sh).
groups.purpose: Simulate the T2 closed-loop test episodes (same episode specs as the T1 test split) that the 2x2 SMC/amortized by T1/T2 grid evaluates.

groups.name: train
groups.purpose: Train one cfcap capability model (set-transformer posterior, direct GNN or ensemble member) of the architecture x training-diversity grid with heterogeneity on; data generated on the fly from seeds.

groups.name: smc-t1
groups.pilot: ESTIMATE (role baselines, 2026-11-25): ~80 s per generator episode for the six baselines (nuisance-SMC dominates: role nuisance's 20/40/70 s per pair/square/2x3 at 192 particles x 100 stages, x1.33 for 256 particles, + candidate propagation and enum/capxfer/RLS ~10-15 s); replace with the measured *_s_mean of scripts/campaigns/baselines_pilot.json bl-canary. The same group with --split cal is needed for the conformal layer (cal rows).
groups.purpose: GPU-SMC posterior baseline on the T1 test split (500 episodes, about a million sims each) for the certified-fraction comparison.

groups.name: gen-ref
groups.purpose: Generate and persist the fixed T1 calibration, test and held-out family splits (H1-H7) with capability labels for conformal calibration and the paper.

groups.name: t0-sweep
groups.purpose: Quasi-static T0 oracle sweeps for the theory phase diagrams on free CPU workers (no rental).

groups.name: t2-eval
groups.purpose: Evaluate the stage-1 trained capability models on the T2 test episodes: coverage, certified fraction and unsafe-go under misspecification.

groups.name: smc-t2
groups.purpose: GPU-SMC with the T1 model on the T2 test episodes: the misspecified cell of the 2x2 SMC/amortized by T1/T2 grid.
